about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm Zhihao Meng, a software engineer at Bitmain Beijing, working on a multi-tenant Agent SaaS platform. I enjoy breaking down complex requirements into running systems—from Agent orchestration engines and RAG knowledge bases to Token billing and full-chain observability.
about.p2: Beyond work, I continuously explore AI engineering—multi-agent collaboration, context engineering, and observability—often tearing apart open-source frameworks to understand them deeply before extending them. If these topics interest you, let's connect!
exp.title: Work Experience
exp.sub: At Bitmain, I lead the core engine and full-chain engineering of a multi-tenant Agent SaaS platform.
exp.bitmain.b1: Contributing to a multi-tenant Agent SaaS platform (>8 models) on Alibaba Cloud ECS + ACK K8s + SLB, responsible for the Agent orchestration engine, RAG knowledge base, Token metering & billing, and full-chain observability—delivering end-to-end from gateway to inference containers.
exp.bitmain.b2: Agent Orchestration Engine: Built DAG workflows & state-machine visual orchestration (branch/loop/parallel/human approval) on LangGraph, integrated Function Calling + MCP (98% success rate), ReAct + Plan-and-Execute hybrid reasoning (completion rate 55%→76%), hierarchical memory with on-demand recall (per-session Token -35%).
exp.bitmain.b3: RAG Knowledge Base: End-to-end pipeline (6 formats, 10M+ chunks), bge-m3 dense/sparse multi-vector hybrid retrieval + Rerank (recall 72%→91%, TTFT 800ms), query rewriting + HyDE + multi-path retrieval (hit rate +18%), RAGAS + 500-example benchmark.
exp.bitmain.b4: Token Metering & Billing: Streaming real-time metering (error <0.1%, incl. Context Cache), Redis+Lua idempotent atomic billing (>1000 QPS, 100% consistency), 48-model tiered pricing + TPM/RPM dual rate limiting (>800K TPM/120RPM), daily reconciliation error <0.01%.
exp.bitmain.b5: Observability: OpenTelemetry-based full LLM trace + self-built dashboards (MTTR -60%), dual-channel content safety (sensitive words + model review, injection block >99%, false positive <2%), SLO + tiered alerting (availability >99.9%).
